chunks: I will cut off your hands and feet on alternate sides, then I will crucify you all.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of cutting hands and feet on alternate sides in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse (7:124) records the Prophet's response to Pharaoh's threat of crucifixion and limb amputation, serving as a foundational text for *al-muqattala* (punishment for highway robbery/rebellion) in Islamic jurisprudence. Shia scholars emphasize its dual application as both a specific historical warning to the Quraysh and a general legal ruling (*hadd*) for those who wage war against God and the Prophet, highlighting the severity of political and spiritual rebellion.
